integrity.method: Analytic proof with separate numerical consistency checks
integrity.numerical_checks: 540 finite-time projective identities and 20 long-time assertions; not used as the infinite proof

scientific_limitations: Homogeneous positive demographic rates \(r>d>0\), directed finite path, strictly positive predation and initial abundances
Only deterministic well-mixed dynamics; not stochastic, spatial, or unequal demographic-rate models
Limit abundances and extinction prefactors given by convergent trajectory integrals
title: Global parity selection and sharp extinction rates in hierarchical May–Leonard chains
